gaps.skill_gap: Two things had no home. First, a spawner - a pad that periodically produces a collectible on a timer - is a distinct spatial object across obby, simulation, and pet games, and no option covers it; collectible-nodes is a static pickup and winner-zone is a reward area, so the request splits awkwardly across both. Second, 'no 2D UI, everything is a physical 3D station' is a global build constraint, not an option, and the emit schema has no place for constraints, so it had to be smuggled into layout_placement as a null-id entry.

notes: Stage A was Unrecognised: the prompt is a destruction sandbox, which matches no genre. It was resolved to Simulation because 'you can destroy buildings with natural disasters' says the player causes the disasters. If the player instead survives them it is Survival, and the shape and options change completely.

Simulation's Physics Sim preset carries the destructible and environmental-hazard options, which is the only reason this classification works. The rest of the genre - tycoons, plots, progression gates - does not apply.
'Super realistic graphics and physics' is a fidelity requirement, not a layout feature. It is carried as free text because there is no field for it.

A massive city at region scale cannot be framed in a single top-down image with buildings legible enough to destroy individually. A decomposed frame - city silhouette plus per-district passes - is the realistic alternative.

gaps.skill_gap: The prompt asks for a screen-space shop and purchasable gear, which are real parts of the build with no spatial existence at all.
